1. **Calculate RF:**
$$\text{RF} = \frac{\text{Length on Map}}{\text{Actual Length}} = \frac{1\text{ cm}}{3\text{ m}} = \frac{1\text{ cm}}{300\text{ cm}} = \frac{1}{300}$$
2. **Maximum Length ($L_{max}$):** $70\text{ m}$.
3. **Length of Scale:** $\text{RF} \times L_{max} = \frac{1}{300} \times 7000\text{ cm} = 23.33\text{ cm}$.
4. **Construction:** Draw a line 23.33 cm long, divide it into 7 equal parts (each representing 10m). Subdivide the first major part into 10 equal divisions (each representing 1m). To show 57m, take 5 major divisions (50m) to the right and 7 subdivisions to the left.
proTip: Always write the RF clearly below the drawn scale and show units.
